Thanks for helping the map grow! Fill in what you know — leave anything blank
if you're not sure (please **don't guess** contact details; a link to the real
site is worth more than a maybe).

**Name:**

**City, State:** <!-- e.g. Austin, TX -->

**Category:** <!-- one of: con, meetup, ctf, maker (hackerspace/makerspace), school, library, youth, gov, hamradio, testing, accelerator -->

**Website / signup link:**

**What is it, in a sentence or two?** <!-- who it's for, what happens there -->

**Is it beginner-friendly?** <!-- yes / no / not sure — e.g. welcomes newcomers, has a beginner track or village, "just show up" -->

**Anything dated?** <!-- next event date (YYYY-MM-DD) + the date range as text, if it's a con or one-off -->

**How did you hear about it / source:** <!-- optional, helps us verify -->
